svg.title: Man-at-Arms: Plunderspell bestiary concept sheet

text.tspan: The one guard who comes to check on a noise. Mail-armoured, sword-
The garrison proper: a full mail hauberk under an undyed linen surcoat,
Kettle helm with a wide beaten-steel brim over a mail coif.
Arming sword sheathed at the left hip. It is only drawn in combat
Walking pose, head turned toward something he just heard: capable and
Madder: None: stirred, not yet roused.
